method.liquidity_ambiguity_rule: Both raw close x volume and raw VWAP x volume were evaluated. The event is rejected because both 20-session medians are below the frozen $2,000,000 threshold.
method.outcome_boundary: The 2020-02-26 event-session bar is excluded because the clinical result was disclosed pre-market at 07:30 ET.

rows.valid_session_floor_evidence: MNLO had traded since its January 2018 IPO, so the February 2020 event had far more than 60 valid post-listing sessions.
rows.determination_sufficiency: The frozen liquidity-floor failure independently rejects the event; market-cap and other non-rescuing floors cannot reverse this result.
rows.market_data_retrieval_note: Only complete pre-event SIP daily bars were used. Event-day and post-event bars were not used in the eligibility determination.
